title: Chapter 266 - 266 Snatching; Lin Fan'S Principle!
content:
Chapter 266 - 266 Snatching; Lin Fan'S Principle!

Chapter 266 - 266 Snatching; Lin Fan's Principle!

266 Snatching; Lin Fan’s Principle!

As soon as the bald man finished speaking, many higher-ups nodded slightly.

Obviously, they agreed with him.

They had been in the entertainment industry for too long and had seen too many such things.

On the internet, there were often people who suddenly appeared with high popularity.

However, these people were often like small sand dunes. Once the waves hit them, nothing would be left.

Zhao Peng said, “I know. Well, it’s useless for me to say more. You should understand after watching this video.”

Then, he turned on the projector.

Immediately, Ling Rou, who was wearing the Star diamond dress, appeared on the screen. She was holding a microphone and singing Galaxy.

Watching this…

The pupils of all the higher-ups present constricted, and their faces were filled with shock and intoxication.

When the video ended, everyone was still staring at the projector. The entire conference room fell into silence.

Zhao Peng looked around and explained, “This is the video I recorded at the concert today. The phone’s functions are limited, so be it her singing or her stage presence, they aren’t conveyed very well… The feeling I had at the scene was definitely several times better than this!”

At this moment, the chairman, who had been sitting at the head of the table and had not spoken all this time, said, “Just do as Director Zhao said just now and do your best to establish a partnership with Ling Rou!”

The final blow!

…

In fact, Gundong Entertainment was not the only entertainment company that had its eyes on Ling Rou.

Those companies either had a meeting at night like Gundong Entertainment, or they were prepared to wait until tomorrow morning to discuss it. Perhaps they were already working on a plan…

The timing was different, but their goal was the same. They wanted Ling Rou to cooperate with them!

…

Lin Fan and Ling Rou had no idea about all of this yet.

The next day, when a gentle breeze blew past the treetops, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes.

He looked at Ling Rou, who was lying quietly beside him, and the bright red marks on the white bed that looked like plum blossoms. He could not help but smile.

At this moment, Ling Rou seemed to have sensed something. Her long eyelashes trembled slightly.

When she saw Lin Fan in front of her, she could not help but recall what had happened yesterday. She was like a shy rabbit, her face flushing red as she buried her head in the blanket.

Her movements seemed to be a little too big. She felt a tearing pain in her lower abdomen, and a pearl-like teardrop rolled down her beautiful eyes.

“Ling Rou, are you alright?” Lin Fan asked with concern.”

“…I’m fine,” Ling Rou said with some difficulty.

At this moment, Ling Rou’s phone rang.

She turned her body with difficulty as if she wanted to pick up her phone.

Lin Fan said, “Let me help you.”

As he spoke, he directly handed the phone to Ling Rou.

Ling Rou looked at the caller ID and saw that it was an unknown number. After a moment of hesitation, she still picked up the call.

“May I ask if this is Ms. Ling Rou?” a magnetic voice came from the phone.

“Yes, it’s me. May I ask who you are?” Ling Rou said softly.

“Hello, Ms. Ling. I’m Zhang Xiaoqian, the general manager of Gundong Entertainment. I wonder if you’re willing to cooperate with our company? Our Gundong Entertainment Company is willing to give you leading roles in TV shows and movies, let you release records, go on variety shows… You’ll also receive more than ten million yuan if you sign a contract with us,” Zhang Xiaoqian said.

Ling Rou’s expression changed slightly when she heard the voice on the phone.

Although she was only a resident singer at the bar, that did not mean that she knew nothing about entertainment companies.

On the contrary, she was very familiar with entertainment companies.

That was because when she was free, she would pay attention to the entertainment news.

She knew that… Gundong Entertainment was one of the top ten entertainment companies in the country.

She had once dreamed of entering such a big company.

Now… Gundong Entertainment was actually taking the initiative to call her?

Furthermore, she was even being offered a contract that would pay her ten million yuan. She would be able to appear on TV shows and movies, release records, and go on variety shows!

This… Even in Ling Rou’s dreams, she had never dreamed of these things!

After a while, Ling Rou came back to her senses.

However, she did not say anything immediately. Instead, she looked at Lin Fan.

She understood that the reason for this call was entirely because of Lin Fan.

Then, Ling Rou said, “Uhh… I need to think about it first.”

“We, Gundong Entertainment, really hope to work with you,” Zhang Xiaoqian said. “Of course, I know that this matter requires careful consideration. If you have any other requests, you can tell us. Our Gundong Entertainment has high hopes for you. At the same time, we also have great sincerity…”

Ling Rou and Zhang Xiaoqian chatted for a while before hanging up.

She had just hung up but received a few more calls.

Without exception, they were all the top entertainment companies in Hua Nation.

Every entertainment company offered very generous terms.

Ling Rou looked at her phone and hesitated.

Lin Fan gently stroked Ling Rou’s hair and said, “You want to go into the entertainment industry?”

Ling Rou nodded.

Lin Fan was not surprised by this answer.

Whether it was Ling Rou’s musical ability or her ability to perform on stage, everything showed that she was very suitable for performing and singing.

Lin Fan said, “If you like it, then go for it. I won’t keep you by my side. If you run into any trouble, you have to tell me at any time because you’re my woman!”

His words were overbearing yet sweet, making Ling Rou blush even more.

Lin Fan was not just saying this casually. He had always kept his word.

Otherwise, he could just have all his women live in the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex. He did not have to do anything and could guarantee that everyone would have no worries about food and clothing for the rest of their lives.

Instead, he let Qin Yuxuan start an investment company in Modu, he let Chu Yunyue manage Flower Stem, and he let Hu Tian continue to be a lecturer…

If one loved someone, one should give them enough freedom, not tie them tightly to one’s side.

Lin Fan said, “You must be a little tired from yesterday. Have a good rest. I’ll get someone to send some breakfast over.”

“Alright,” Ling Rou replied.

Then, Lin Fan slowly got up and walked out. He first sent a reservation message to the Michelin restaurant.

After washing up and sitting on the sofa, the phone in his pocket rang.

“Mr. Lin, am I disturbing your rest?” Wang Fengyi, the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, spoke through the phone.

“No, I’ve been awake for a while,” Lin Fan said.

Wang Fengyi heaved a sigh of relief and said, “Yesterday’s concert cost a total of 149 million yuan. I’ve already sent the details to your WeChat… In addition, there’s still 351 million left from the 500 million you gave me. Shall I return it directly to your Merchant Bank account?”
